retrievalProfile.description: A dual-portrait composition featuring high-contrast, low-key lighting with bold, condensed sans-serif typography layered across the top.
triggerTerms: condensed blue and white typography overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by two close-up male portraits emerging from a dark, near-black background. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting facial features while leaving the lower half in deep shadow. The top third features two layers of bold, condensed sans-serif text in contrasting blue and white, with a small yellow rectangular 'hype sticker' element in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-over-face layering in the upper quadrant
Primary color accents (blue, yellow) against a dark neutral base
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space in the lower half
Warm-toned skin highlights against cool-toned blue text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale portraits flanking the center, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white text of the secondary title line centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large blue title at the top, down to the white subtitle, then following the gaze of the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space at the bottom and between the two faces.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for secondary text and facial highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium cerulean blue for primary title and mustard yellow for the sticker element
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin highlights and background; moderate saturation in blue and yellow accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to one primary blue and one muted yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar condensed grotesques.
graphicDevices: Rectangular yellow sticker element with small serif text
Circular logo in upper right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the primary title.
Provides the clean, mid-century Swiss feel for the subtitle.
Captures the vintage American advertising aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image featuring two men in a dual portrait. Use low-key lighting with deep shadows, leaving the bottom half of the frame black. The men should have 1960s hairstyles and be looking slightly off-camera. The background is solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase, extra-condensed sans-serif text at the top. The top line should be large and blue; the second line should be smaller and white. Add a small yellow rectangle in the upper right with tiny black serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the text condensed and uppercase?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Are there two distinct subjects in the portrait?
Is the color palette limited to black, blue, white, and yellow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure eyes of the subjects
Verify the blue color is a solid mid-tone cerulean
Check that the lower half of the image remains dark and uncluttered
recipe.reuseFormula: Dual portrait + low-key lighting + condensed sans-serif overlay = 1960s Soul Aesthetic
